notes: Heading: 'E. Urbita Hot Springs Co., at road corner east of resort, San Bernardino quadrangle.' under 'Records of pressure of water in flowing wells in San Bernardino Valley--Continued'. 'E' is the report's own well letter. Quadrangle (San Bernardino) not given a field; kept here. No county or state printed. Variable is artesian pressure in pounds per square inch; entered as water_level (no 'pressure' in the list; could be 'other'). Count: left column 6 (1916: 2, 1917: 2, 1918: 2) + right column 4 (1919: 2, 1920: 2) = 10.
